newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles County must keep $50 mln - governor.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles County must keep $50 mln - governor.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson signed legislation Monday ensuring Los Angeles County can keep the $50 million it took from the Metropolitan Transportation Authority during its 1995 budget crisis.
A Superior Court judge ruled last December that the transfer from the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority to the county general fund violated California's Constitution.
The county has appealed the decision.
Legislation signed Monday by Wilson will ensure that Los Angeles County will not be required to reimburse the transit agency even if the appeals court invalidates the transfer.
The $50 million transfer helped Los Angeles County balance its budget.
